caption: The drawing depicts a long, flowing dress with a fitted bodice and short, ruffled sleeves. The dress is primarily white or off-white and features a pattern of small red flowers scattered throughout the fabric. The bodice has a deep V-neckline bordered by wide ruffles, which are outlined and detailed with a bright red color. The ruffles also edge the sleeves and the neckline, matching the floral pattern below. The skirt of the dress is full and gathered at the waist, falling to the hem in soft pleats with the floral print evenly distributed. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller version of the same dress, which includes a depiction with an additional pink or red waistband or sash and sheer long sleeves beneath the ruffled short sleeves, reiterating the same floral motif and ruffle details. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or designs.
title: Girl's Dress
